department: College of Computing (Schools of Computer Science, Interactive Computing, Cybersecurity & Privacy, Computational Science & Engineering)

deadline.value: Apply by 15 December 2026; all materials must arrive by the deadline (the CSE home school's CS PhD track closes 1 February 2027).
deadline.quote: The application deadline for the Ph.D. in Computer Science is December 15th.

also.quote: Computer Science - On Campus (School of Computer Science) Computer Science Computing Atlanta Doctoral Fall 2026 Fall 2027 12/15/2025 12/15/2026

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

gre_general.value: The GRE General is optional; recently admitted applicants averaged about the 80th/90th+/90th+ percentiles.
gre_general.quote: General Graduate Record Examination (GRE) scores are optional.

toefl_min.value: CS needs TOEFL iBT 100 (or 5.0 on the new scale), above the Institute minimum.
toefl_min.quote: The required minimum is 100 on the older scale, and 5.0 on the new scale effective January 2026.

ielts_min.value: CS needs IELTS 7.5 overall with Reading/Listening/Speaking 6.5 and Writing 5.5.
ielts_min.quote: A minimum overall score of 7.5 is required, with minimum section scores as follows: Reading 6.5, Listening 6.5, Speaking 6.5, Writing 5.5.

supervisor.value: The CS admissions page does not say whether a supervisor's agreement is needed before applying.

funding.value: PhD candidates are typically offered a research or teaching assistantship with a stipend and tuition remission.
funding.quote: Ph.D. candidates are typically offered a research or teaching assistantship which includes a stipend and tuition remission.

entry_route.value: Apply straight to the PhD (the MS is a separate program); a strong undergraduate GPA (desirably 3.5/4.0) is expected.
entry_route.quote: If the eventual degree you seek is a Ph.D., you will need to apply directly to the doctoral program. | The desirable minimum undergraduate GPA is 3.5/4.0.

notes: One CS PhD across several College of Computing schools; you pick a home school in the application. The English test is waived after at least one year of study in the US.
